docking.center_note: co-crystallised mitapivat (WV2) centroid, chain B — verified by dock._ligand_center; FBP (20 atoms) correctly not picked
docking.correction_note: Pipeline docked only mitapivat (-12.02) on 7FS3 (LIVER pyruvate kinase, PKL, with modulator 15) because ChEMBL ligand retrieval returned no_data. 7FS3 is the same PKLR gene but the wrong isoform for a red-cell paper; this run uses 8XFD, erythrocyte PK with mitapivat itself bound, and adds etavopivat + tebapivat. The 7FS3 score is retained only as a cross-isoform sensitivity check.
